WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT 'P05' AS rng,
         SUM(net_sales) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web,
         SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales END) AS stores, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Sep', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales END), COUNT(*)
  FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT 'P05' AS rng, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_total, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS ctl_web
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Sep', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END)
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT m.*, c.ctl_total, c.ctl_web FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (rng)

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS l0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS l1,
       COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), NULL, NULL, NULL, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

SELECT r.business_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN store_id END) AS stores,
       SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web, SUM(receipts) AS receipts
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date = DATE '2026-09-01' AND store_id<900),
b AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date = DATE '2026-08-31' AND store_id<900)
SELECT a.store_id, s.store_name, s.city, s.region, s.is_current,
  (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales x WHERE x.store_id=a.store_id AND x.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-08-30')/7 AS avg_prev_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store ds ON ds.store_key=f.store_key WHERE ds.store_id=a.store_id AND f.sale_date=DATE '2026-08-31') AS lines_0831,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load f JOIN dim_store ds ON ds.store_key=f.store_key WHERE ds.store_id=a.store_id AND f.sale_date=DATE '2026-08-31') AS stg_lines_0831
FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=a.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE b.store_id IS NULL

SELECT 'kemi' AS k, CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS a, CAST(net_sales AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(receipts AS VARCHAR) AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=133 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-06'
UNION ALL SELECT 'closure', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_end_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
UNION ALL SELECT 'store', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), store_name || '/' || format || '/' || region, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) || ' ' || CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) || ' close=' || COALESCE(CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR),'-') FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=133 OR close_date IS NOT NULL OR open_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'

SELECT 'order_status' AS k, o.status AS a, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_disp, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS dist
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', s.store_id::VARCHAR, COUNT(*), 0, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_lines_with_order', s.store_id::VARCHAR, COUNT(*), 0, 0
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'excluded_999_ZZ', CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN '999' ELSE 'other' END || '/' || CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 'ZZ' ELSE 'ok' END, COUNT(*), 0, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount))
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_week_start_date AS wk, o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(o.order_total_gross)) AS gross,
       MIN(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS first_order
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' AND o.status IN ('processing','cancelled')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) AS net,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS mn, MAX(f.sale_date) AS mx,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' THEN f.net_amount END),2) AS net_p05_by_sale_date,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' THEN f.net_amount END),2) AS net_sep_by_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY 1

SELECT 'ret_date_vs_ts' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN return_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN return_date <> CAST(return_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_mismatch
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sale_date_vs_ts', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date <> CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_returns', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
